buildReceipt.configurationEvidence: Recorded CMake cache settings and probe location; no build flags inferred from filenames.

method: Eight sequential fresh processes using one Release probe linked to both engines: full Canon then full Canon2; three scan-only pairs ordered Canon/Canon2, Canon2/Canon, Canon/Canon2. Filesystem cache is uncontrolled. No Windows/NEXIS or cold-cache claim follows from a macOS run.

proofScope.full: Complete recursive graphs, alias topology, projections, direct original-reader equality and exact Canon2 native database bytes, plus scan/CSV evidence.
proofScope.scan: Final row/evidence, scheduling, issues, callbacks, completion, CSV and unchanged input stamps. Source graph/projection/original-byte verification is omitted.
proofScope.storage: Representation differences are reported separately. Canon2 requires zero database archives and unfinished graphs; media header archives are expected.

performance.definition: Medians use only three scan-mode trials per engine. Negative changePercent means Canon2 uses less time/memory. Current and peak process counters are sampled by the probe before verification/CSV; absent counters are not treated as zero.

nativeDatabaseByteProof.scope: Every opened Canon2 PMR/MDB image directly compared byte-for-byte with its unchanged original file in the full run. Timing trials do not repeat this proof.

releaseTestSuites.scanSkipReason: Temporary filesystem does not preserve case-distinct file locations

verificationReceipt.implementationScope: Native PMR/MDB RAM images using verified Canon readers; shared scheduling/selection; no live engine switch
